entries.name: RRRTX FreeVerse
entries.blurb: Free quiz-based certificates with QR-verifiable PDFs and a public registry repo. A small obsession made functional: verification as a default, not a paywall.

entries.name: TruthCI
entries.blurb: Detects contradictions between a product's website, pricing, docs and API behavior. Deterministic diffing first; AI only explains. Landing + auth flow live; engine honestly unbuilt.

entries.name: AegisRoute
entries.blurb: Offline-first notification routing: decide what interrupts you, and be able to prove why. Built in one evening as a full README package — the badge claims are mine to defend, so the source is the receipt. Rebuild with xr-grade CI is on the list.

entries.name: NovaWeather
entries.blurb: Cinematic mission-control weather app on WebGL Earth, built entirely on free open data. Grew out of a job-assessment submission and got rebuilt properly.

entries.name: The Lost Signal
entries.blurb: An interactive fiction game — prose, ambient audio, JSON-defined souls. Written, not generated. Proof that the runtime needs a human side.

entries.name: brainrot-iq
entries.blurb: Daily AI-generated internet-culture quiz with leaderboard and share cards. The engineering bit: Groq generates the questions, a curated fallback bank guarantees the app never breaks on an API outage.

entries.name: SHIPPED™
entries.blurb: An enterprise standup generator that produces the illusion of progress. Deliberately contains no AI — that's the joke. Dev.to April Fools entry; the writing is all mine, the scaffold was bot-drafted, which the repo history happily shows.

entries.name: SoulSpace
entries.blurb: Anonymous peer-support chat: ephemeral by design, no persisted logs, and a crisis-resources disclaimer before anything else. Right instincts for a build I'd now harden differently.

entries.name: HireReady
entries.blurb: Role-specific portfolio project ideas from a one-line goal, with a mind-map roadmap viewer. Built in a day for job-hunting freelancers, myself included.
